record.result: I added `TaskStore.paginate(offset=0, limit=10)` in `src/tasklib/store.py`. It returns a new list holding the stored `Task` objects, slice by slice, in creation order, completed ones included. A zero limit or an offset past the end returns `[]`. Both arguments must be nonnegative `int`s; `bool`, other types and negative values raise `ValueError`. It only reads the store, so tasks, creation order and the next-ID counter are unchanged. The visible tests pass (127 passed).
